name: uia-mcp
description: Windows UI Automation tools for GitHub Copilot and MCP clients - inspect desktop elements, focused controls, handles, class names, and automation IDs

commands.title: UI Automation MCP: Copy CLI Command
UI Automation MCP: Reveal Bundled Tools

scripts.clean: cd .. && dotnet build-server shutdown && dotnet clean src/UIAutomationMcp.McpServer/UIAutomationMcp.McpServer.csproj -c Release -nodeReuse:false && dotnet clean src/UIAutomationMcp.CLI/UIAutomationMcp.CLI.csproj -c Release -nodeReuse:false
scripts.copy:skills: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const copy=(src,dst)=>{ if(!fs.existsSync(src)) return; fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true}); for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(src,{withFileTypes:true})) { const s=path.join(src,entry.name); const d=path.join(dst,entry.name); if (entry.isDirectory()) copy(s,d); else fs.copyFileSync(s,d); } }; copy(path.join('skills-src','uia-mcp'), path.join('skills','uia-mcp')); copy(path.join('skills-src','uia-cli'), path.join('skills','uia-cli'));"
scripts.build:mcp-server: npm run clean && npm run clean:bin && cd .. && dotnet publish src/UIAutomationMcp.McpServer/UIAutomationMcp.McpServer.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -p:PublishTrimmed=false -p:PublishReadyToRun=false -p:NuGetAudit=false -nodeReuse:false -o vscode-extension/bin --verbosity minimal
scripts.build:cli: cd .. && dotnet publish src/UIAutomationMcp.CLI/UIAutomationMcp.CLI.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -p:PublishTrimmed=false -p:PublishReadyToRun=false -p:NuGetAudit=false -nodeReuse:false -o vscode-extension/bin --verbosity minimal
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:mcp-server && npm run build:cli && npm run copy:skills && npm run copy:changelog && npm run compile
